project_description: Redesign and rebuild the Accountability Lab global nonprofit website with improved UX, accessibility, multilingual support, and performance. Includes migration from the existing CMS, integration with donation and newsletter platforms, and a refreshed design system aligned to the Lab's visual identity.

Build a new IPPF website to reflect a global rebrand launching in late 2026. The selected agency will collaborate with the rebrand team to integrate brand assets, design system, and messaging into a new responsive website with multilingual capability and regional federation hubs.

Redesign of the City of Willow Springs municipal website with implementation of a hosted web content management solution. Goals include extending city services online, reducing paperwork, and improving citizen-facing user experience. Hosting and ongoing maintenance to be provided by the selected vendor.

Engage a Marketing & Outreach Consultant to strengthen and professionalize SeamlessAccess' marketing and outreach efforts. Scope includes audience segmentation, messaging refinement, content calendar development, and campaign execution across the global research and library community.

Implementation support for the Enterprise Community Partners 2026-2030 Strategic Plan, including project management, coordination, progress tracking, and governance support across multiple workstreams. Engagement runs from February through December 2026.
